heard: A blind and mute man was brought to Him Jesus healed him so he could speak and see The crowds were amazed by what they saw Could this be the Son of David? The Pharisees heard and spoke with scorn He said He drives out demons by Beelzebul They doubted the power at work in Him Questioned the Spirit of God's will Every kingdom divided falls apart No city or house will stand alone If Satan casts out Satan, then he casts out God.
